77-07-02-05B.pt: N1 Vibration Indication on the ENGINE SD page
77-07-02-05B.txt:
Repair interval                      Nbr installed              Nbr required             Placard
                    A                                    2                          0                    Yes
     (o)      Both may be inoperative for three flights provided that:
              1) EDTO is not conducted, and
              2) No vibration advisory was displayed during the previous flight.
              Note:      <After Door Closed> Return To Gate
              Note:      <MAINTENANCE>
                         1. Contact MCC for Dispatch Approval.
                         2. Contact MCC for Defer Control.

                                                         Reference(s)
           (o) Refer to OpsProc 77-07-02-05B N1 or N2 Vibration Indication on the ENGINE SD page
77-07-02-05B.ko:
(o) 다음 조건이면 둘 다 3개 비행(three flights) 동안 작동 불능이어도 된다:
1) EDTO를 수행하지 않고,
2) 직전 비행(previous flight)에서 vibration advisory가 표시되지 않았다.
Note: <도어 닫힌 후 발생 시> Return To Gate (게이트로 돌아가 정비 조치 필요)
Note: <MAINTENANCE> (정비 조치)
1. 출발 승인은 MCC에 연락.
2. Defer Control(이연 관리)은 MCC에 연락.
참조
(o) OpsProc 77-07-02-05B N1 or N2 Vibration Indication on the ENGINE SD page 참조 (운항 절차 — 아래 운항 절차 칸)
